pipelines.name: Build and deploy production

steps.name: Remove translations from fastlane metadata
steps.run:
mv fastlane/metadata/android fastlane/metadata/android_orig
mkdir fastlane/metadata/android
mv fastlane/metadata/android_orig/en-US fastlane/metadata/android/

steps.name: Build and deploy to Google Play

findings: [CRITICAL] NO_TEST_GATE: CRITICAL: Job 'deploy' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).
[MEDIUM] NO_CACHE: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
[HIGH] UNPINNED_ACTION: Job 'deploy' step 3 uses unpinned action 'ruby/setup-ruby@v1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
[HIGH] UNPINNED_ACTION: Job 'deploy' step 4 uses unpinned action 'android-actions/setup-android@v4'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
[HIGH] UNPINNED_ACTION: Job 'deploy' step 5 uses unpinned action 'timheuer/base64-to-file@v1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
[HIGH] EXCESSIVE_PERMISSIONS: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
[LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'deploy' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.
[MEDIUM] ARTIFACT_CREDENTIAL_PERSISTENCE: Job 'deploy' runs actions/checkout without 'persist-credentials: false' and uploads build artifacts.

anti_patterns.message: CRITICAL: Job 'deploy' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).
anti_patterns.remediation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

anti_patterns.message: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
anti_patterns.remediation: Enable built-in caching on setup-* actions (e.g., cache: 'pip' or 'npm') or add an explicit actions/cache step.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'deploy' step 3 uses unpinned action 'ruby/setup-ruby@v1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'deploy' step 4 uses unpinned action 'android-actions/setup-android@v4'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'deploy' step 5 uses unpinned action 'timheuer/base64-to-file@v1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'deploy' runs actions/checkout without 'persist-credentials: false' and uploads build artifacts.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set 'with: persist-credentials: false' on actions/checkout steps in jobs that upload artifacts.
